name: Personal Responsibility
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that personal responsibility is essential before God, as each individual is accountable for their own actions and choices. The Lord calls His people to heed His commandments diligently and to take ownership of their sin by confessing and forsaking it, promising mercy to those who do so. Responsibility is emphasized in both spiritual devotion—loving God fully and loving one’s neighbor—and in moral accountability, where the consequences of sin rest upon the sinner alone. Believers are encouraged to courageously embrace the tasks God assigns, recognizing that their obedience leads to blessing and honor among the nations.
